cli.assets_missing: Web assets missing; install the package built with scripts/build_distribution.py.

preferences.invalid: The stored language preferences are invalid; save them again in Preferences before starting new work.
preferences.key_reused: This idempotency key already names a different preferences change.
session.limit: Close a session or restart the service.
session.rate_limited: Wait a minute before trying to sign in again.
session.required: Session missing, closed or expired. Sign in; no action will be repeated automatically.
